summary:
Floe is a browser app for sending files directly between devices (P2P), with end-to-end encryption and no accounts. I saved 2 views, and both replayed correctly:
1) home-send (/): the main screen. It has the Send card (a drop zone for files, latency and Ready status), the "62.39 TB transferred globally" counter, and the landing sections below it: how it works, privacy, CLI install tabs, desktop, capabilities and FAQ.
2) download (/download): the Floe Desktop download page, with a Microsoft Store button, version and release info, and a picture of the desktop app's send panel.

What I couldn't reach:
- The states after choosing files (share link, QR code, room code, transfer progress). Getting there needs the operating system's file picker, which the browser actions here can't fill in.
- A working request-link page. /r/<id> without the secret part of the link only shows an "incomplete link" error.
- A receive screen. Opening / with a #room on the end still shows the normal home page.

What I skipped:
- /how-it-works, /privacy and /terms, because they are documentation or legal pages.
